授業概要
対象敷地の地震動評価においては，地下構造のモデル化が不可欠である．本演習はゼミナール形式で実施し，論文の輪読および強震記録の解析を通じて，地盤構造の把握手法について実践的に学ぶ．
Modeling subsurface structures is essential for evaluating ground motions at a target site. This seminar-style course, conducted through case studies, focuses on methods for estimating subsurface velocity structures from strong-motion records.
